output.content:
**Answer: needs_information — no defensible feasible recipe can be produced from this characterization, and I did not select an operating recipe.**

The simulation could not run: the native LyoPRONTO simulator rejected the source with the error **"Missing characterized inputs: product.R0"** — the initial dried-layer resistance parameter `product.R0` is absent from the characterization source (LyoPRONTO-native-case:LPN-44ee4e4e94, revision 1) and from every authorized record I searched at this site, so I could not check whether the single allowed pressure/shelf pair (0.1 Torr, −15 °C shelf) is feasible, nor report completion time, maximum vial-bottom temperature, peak whole-batch sublimation rate, or any margin. Because R0 is an essential characterized input, no native simulation result was produced, so there are no simulation result_ids to include.

What the source **does** supply: vial geometry (vial area 3.14 cm², cross-section 3.8 cm², fill 2.885 mL), vial heat-transfer coefficients, product `A1` 15.9415, critical vial-bottom temperature −5 °C, solids 0.05 g/mL, the whole-batch equipment line (kg/h) with a = −0.182 and b = 11.7 per Torr, 398 vials, a 3600-minute horizon, and the single recipe candidate (0.1 Torr, −15 °C). This is an authored simulator-world source marked synthetic with no experimental measurements, so even a completed run would be simulation, not validation.

**Not saved:** I attempted to record this assessment via the result-recording tool, but it was not saved (the tool rejected the save). The assessment above stands as my answer; the missing item that would settle it is a characterized `product.R0` (dried-layer resistance) from an authorized source.
